problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate shipments from a network of distribution centers to a series of retail outlets in order to minimize total freight expense.

The inventory available at each distribution center (set C) is as follows:
*C1 has 130 units.
*C2 has 191 units.
*C3 has 105 units.
*C4 has 101 units.
*C5 has 103 units.
*C6 has 124 units.
*C7 has 138 units.
*C8 has 83 units.
*C9 has 95 units.
*C10 has 178 units.

The required fulfillment at each retail outlet (set R) is specified below:
*R1 must receive 90 units.
*R2 must receive 100 units.
*R3 must receive 107 units.
*R4 must receive 80 units.
*R5 must receive 82 units.
*R6 must receive 133 units.
*R7 must receive 99 units.
*R8 must receive 94 units.
*R9 must receive 125 units.
*R10 must receive 75 units.

The per-unit freight cost from each distribution center to each retail outlet is detailed in the following matrix:

| From / To | R1 | R2 | R3 | R4 | R5 | R6 | R7 | R8 | R9 | R10 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| C1 | 14 | 1 | 17 | 4 | 1 | 13 | 5 | 2 | 2 | 7 |
| C2 | 9 | 6 | 10 | 9 | 5 | 2 | 10 | 7 | 18 | 2 |
| C3 | 12 | 15 | 4 | 20 | 18 | 8 | 18 | 13 | 8 | 17 |
| C4 | 10 | 2 | 13 | 13 | 14 | 11 | 18 | 2 | 1 | 9 |
| C5 | 7 | 20 | 15 | 8 | 12 | 19 | 18 | 20 | 7 | 7 |
| C6 | 10 | 15 | 6 | 3 | 6 | 6 | 17 | 4 | 13 | 2 |
| C7 | 14 | 9 | 18 | 9 | 5 | 6 | 19 | 9 | 1 | 11 |
| C8 | 15 | 5 | 2 | 5 | 11 | 20 | 2 | 20 | 10 | 16 |
| C9 | 19 | 18 | 12 | 3 | 11 | 17 | 8 | 6 | 17 | 3 |
| C10 | 17 | 6 | 14 | 18 | 18 | 13 | 3 | 12 | 8 | 7 |

Determine the optimal shipment quantities to achieve the minimal total freight cost.
